# S28 · Admin v5 (prototype alignment)

[All stages](README.md) · [Wave 9](README.md#wave-9) · [README dashboard](../../README.md#all-28-stages) · [Register section](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s28--admin-v5-prototype-alignment--pr-659708)

> **বাংলায় — অ্যাডমিন v5 (প্রোটোটাইপ মেলানো):**
> - ৫২টা PR, সব বানানো শেষ (১৪ নভেম্বর): মেনু আর অর্ডার, কুরিয়ার, রুলস আর অফার, প্রোডাক্ট-ফাইন্যান্স-রিপোর্ট, বাকি সব।
> - যা আগেই বানানো আছে আবার বানানো হয়নি; Lumen ডিজাইনই আছে; কিছু মোছা হয়নি।

**Done:** 201 / 201 PRs (Done) · **Wave:** 9 · **PR numbers:** 659–735, 740–749, 762–781, 783–843, 845–859, 861–868, 980–989 · **Register status:** Complete, 201/201 merged 13–16 Nov 2026; 765–868 filed and built 15–16 Nov (admin parity round 3: Home, Reports, Orders, Products, Customers, Couriers, Website, Marketing, Inbox, Finance, Rules, Offers, Settings and AI Center to the v5 prototype); filed 13 Nov 2026 (CN-048); 709, 710 filed 14 Nov (CN-051); 719–735, 740–749 and 762–764 filed and built 15 Nov (the admin parity round 2, Website › Page settings, the shop customisation cards, the admin menu's tab bar drawn once by the shell, every admin page with the new head; practice pictures that load; the admin menu: every page draws its section's tab bar; the practice shop live, photos, parity rounds, rich sample data, Brand & menus); 711–718 filed and built 14 Nov (the eight prototype tabs that had no PR) — the owner-approved admin prototype v5 becomes the real admin; Lumen stays the look

*Filed 13 Nov 2026 (CN-048). The owner-approved admin prototype v5 (`docs/demo/admin-proto-v5/`) becomes the real admin: mostly re-arranging screens to the prototype's menu and wiring the backend that is already built. Lumen stays the look. Backend that exists (courier booking and stickers, merge rules, incomplete-order capture, coupons, claims, size charts, exchanges, Customer 360, refunds and wallet, Calls to make, Rider issues, notices) is re-used. Full check: `docs/demo/admin-proto-v5/GAP-MAP.md`. Every new number or switch is a backend setting, off by default; every integration runs on a mock until the owner types the key.*

## PR 659

**Admin shell alignment —**

**বাংলায়:** শেলের মেনু প্রোটোটাইপের মতো সাজানো: Home, Orders, Couriers, Inbox, Rules, Finance — Lumen ডিজাইনই থাকছে, কিছু মোছা হচ্ছে না।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-13
  - Build status row: Admin shell alignment (CN-048; no migration, no new permission; `admin.startPages` accepts the new `rules` section): the left menu as the prototype's `A.NAV` inside the Lumen look — Daily = Home, Orders, Couriers, Products, Customers, Inbox, Rules; Grow = Marketing, Website; Business = Finance, Reports; System = AI Center, Settings, Help. Renames by label only (ids, routes and permissions unchanged): Today to Home, Delivery to Couriers, Support to Inbox, Money to Finance. **Rules is its own section** (`rules`, tab All rules: `/admin/rules`, `/notices`, `/eid`; its guide pages moved to `docs/admin-guide/pages/rules/`). **Messages is folded into Marketing › Message campaigns** (all 8 pages and addresses unchanged; the `messages` section id stays as a `folded` entry with no menu item, so saved settings and its manual chapter live on). A click on the open section's name folds or opens its pages (a double-click folds once); the Orders badge reads "in Processing"; icons: Home, Inbox and a new Rules glyph. Bottom bar stays the superset (the prototype's 5-item bar is a phone subset). 3 new test cases, admin guide updated. Updated 13 Nov 2026 (owner decision, binding): the admin opens in English on first open and Bengali only through the EN/বাং switch, like the prototype; a stored cookie choice still wins, and the store's locale no longer decides the admin language (it only sets date and number style). Storefront language untouched.
- **What it does (original scope):** **Admin shell alignment** — Left menu as the prototype: groups Daily / Grow / Business / System, renames (Dashboard to Home, Delivery to Couriers, Support to Inbox, Money to Finance), Rules and Couriers as their own sections, Messages entry moves into Marketing, a click on the open section folds it, 3 new icons, the "?" panel slot and the Admin map slot, Orders badge reads Processing. Lumen stays the look; the burnt-orange accent is one existing swatch. Routes stay, nothing deleted. Size M; depends on —; shared files: sections.ts, lumen-nav.ts, admin-shell.*.json (SOLE OWNER first; merge before any other S28 PR touches them).
- **Filed under:** [S28 Wave 1 — shell and orders](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s28-wave-1--shell-and-orders)
- **Updates and change notes, in date order:**
  - [Scope added to existing PRs, 13 Nov 2026 (CN-048; new PR 659–707)](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#how-this-reached-653): **PR 659** — Updated 13 Nov 2026 (CN-048, follow-up): the real menu equals the prototype's `A.NAV` exactly. `apps/web/src/lib/admin-shell/nav-v5.ts` says, per section, the prototype's tabs in its order and words (a real tab with no prototype tab sits under "More"; nothing deleted, no address changes); `sections.ts` keeps every built page in `RAW_SECTIONS` and `SHELL_SECTIONS` applies it. Entries for pages built in the not-yet-merged lanes (NAV-PATCH of waves 4A, 4B, 5A, 5B: 25 pages, listed in `nav-pending.json`) stay hidden until their `page.tsx` is merged: run `node tools/nav/activate-pending.mjs` after each of those merges (a test fails with that instruction when a page landed and the list is stale). "Add product" is its own Products tab. Tests: `nav-v5.test.ts` (14).
- **What was built** (from the Build status row):
  - Code and files: `docs/admin-guide/pages/rules/`
  - Routes: `/admin/rules`, `/notices`, `/eid`
  - Settings and named keys: `admin.startPages`
  - Names in the code: `rules`, `A.NAV`, `messages`, `folded`
  - Tests: 3 new test cases, admin guide updated
- **Links:** [Register section](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s28-wave-1--shell-and-orders) · [README feature section](../../README.md#s28--admin-v5-prototype-alignment--done-201201) · [↑ PR list](#prs-in-this-stage)

## PR 660

**Orders section re-map and Processing view —**

**বাংলায়:** অর্ডারের ট্যাব প্রোটোটাইপের মতো: Processing একটা ভিউ, তারিখের ফিল্টার আর বাতিল অর্ডারের সারাংশ।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-13
  - Build status row: Orders section re-map and Processing view (CN-048; no migration, no new permission, no new setting): the Orders tabs read All orders, Processing, To ship, With courier, Returns & exchanges, Incomplete orders, and under More the Today's digest and Risk rules (tab ids and every address unchanged; the rider's handover is its own tab, With courier). **Processing is a view, never an order status** (`processing` in `ORDER_VIEWS`: new orders to confirm, waiting for an advance, on hold, or in an open review) and the first chip of the Processing tab (`/admin/orders/confirm`, its old chips stay as its parts, plus On hold and In review). **Cancelled** is a saved view of All orders. The lists get a **date bar** (Today, Yesterday, Last 7 days, This month, Last month, and two day boxes), the days read in the `store.timeZone` setting (`from`/`to` on the list query and on the export; `day-range.ts`, `range.ts`); the risk sort is worded "Lowest courier score first (highest risk)". **Cancelled summary** (`cancelledSummary`, read only): count, order value not collected, the reason split in the owner's words, the stage and who cancelled, with a CSV file (the list's own export, `orders.export`) and a print/PDF button, over the Cancelled view in all three designs. Guides updated. 1 new db test file (8 tests) and 5 new web tests.
- **What it does (original scope):** **Orders section re-map and Processing view** — Orders tabs Batch, All orders, Processing, To ship, With courier, Returns & exchanges, Incomplete orders over the existing pages; old addresses redirect. Processing is a view over To confirm, awaiting advance, hold and open reviews (not an OrderStatus). Date presets and custom range on lists, "lowest courier score" sort, Cancelled summary with Excel/PDF. Size M; depends on 659; shared files: sections.ts, lumen-nav.ts, admin-shell.*.json (tabs only, after 659); orders list query.
- **Filed under:** [S28 Wave 1 — shell and orders](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s28-wave-1--shell-and-orders)

  - Routes: `/admin/orders/confirm`
  - Settings and named keys: `store.timeZone`, `orders.export`
  - Names in the code: `processing`, `ORDER_VIEWS`, `from`, `to`, `cancelledSummary`

## PR 671

**Courier payouts via the courier own request —**

**বাংলায়:** কুরিয়ারের নিজস্ব পেমেন্ট-রিকোয়েস্টে টাকা চাওয়া, স্ট্যাটাস নিজে নিজে ফিরে আসে, Paid হলে অর্ডার সেটেল।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-13
  - Build status row: Courier payouts through the courier's own payment request (CN-048; migration 0220 `CourierPayout`; one new setting `delivery.courier.payouts` v311 (ON by the owner's written OK of 13 Nov, BLOCKED W2-1) with the owner's poll minutes and smallest amount; no new permission; ships ON (owner's OK, 13 Nov), money question in BLOCKED W2-1): Courier 360 › Payouts shows what the courier holds for us (delivered, cash collected, on no statement and in no open request, less its charges), its own balance when it gives one, the open request and the latest ones. "Ask the courier to pay" needs `payments.settle` AND the owner's PIN (`verifyOwnerPin`, never stored or logged) and one request key per press, so a request is asked once; the row is saved first, one request is open at a time, and a courier that did not answer leaves an unconfirmed open request a person closes (never asked twice by guess). Steadfast asks through its own `payment_request`, Pathao only reads, RedX has none (`PAYOUT_NOT_SUPPORTED`); there is no "Ask for payment" of ours. The poll (`courier.payouts` job per slot of the owner's minutes, and "Check now") reads it back REQUESTED → PROCESSING → PAID or REJECTED; PAID settles the covered parcels on an imported statement (`importSettlement`, the same matching as a statement file) in the name of the person who asked, whose `payments.settle` is checked again (else "Mark orders settled" by hand); a paid amount that differs is kept as the courier said and flagged. Never deletes. `PaymentsDeps.couriers` hook (web: `courierApi`; jobs: connections, books and charge-log hooks). Delivery settings gets the "Courier payouts" card. Bengali guide updated. Tests: 7 payments (real PostgreSQL), 1 settings, 1 jobs
- **What it does (original scope):** **Courier payouts via the courier own request** — Request a payout through each courier own payment-request feature (no "Ask for payment"); status Requested, Processing, Paid or Rejected read back by a poll; Paid marks covered orders settled through the existing settlement path. Steadfast first, Pathao read-only, RedX none. Mock until keys. Size L; depends on 670, 672; shared files: Prisma (CourierPayout); adapter contract (optional payouts capability).
- **Filed under:** [S28 Wave 2 — couriers](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s28-wave-2--couriers)

## PR 674

**Courier messages —**

**বাংলায়:** কুরিয়ারকে পাঠানো মেসেজ নিজে এডিট করা যায়, প্রতি ইভেন্টের জন্য আলাদা।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-13
  - Build status row: Courier messages (CN-048; one new setting `delivery.courier.messages` v313 OFF; no migration, no new permission): an editable text per event (booking note, delivery instruction, COD line, re-attempt, hold, cancel, return pick-up, claim, payout) in English and Bengali with the placeholders {order}, {customer}, {cod}, {courier}, {date}, {amount}, {consignment} (any other placeholder is refused on save, 240 characters a text, starting words the owner edits). While the owner's "Use these texts" switch is on, the booking, delivery and (only for a parcel with cash to collect) COD texts are added to the parcel's note that the adapters already pass to the courier (in the booking card's note language) and the payout text becomes the payout request's note; the other texts are offered to copy. The booking dialogs (Pack, one order or the ticked ones) get a one-off note (200 characters, `bookInput.note`) that leads the parcel's note, whatever the switch. Delivery settings gets the "Messages to the courier" card; Courier 360 gets a Messages section (the nine texts in both languages with "Copy"). Nothing is sent to a courier by itself. Bengali guides updated (Courier 360, Delivery settings, Pack). Tests: 4 pure, 1 booking and 1 payout (real PostgreSQL), 2 settings
- **What it does (original scope):** **Courier messages** — Editable text per event (booking note, delivery instruction, COD line, re-attempt, hold, cancel, return pick-up, claim, payout) with placeholders in EN and BN, plus a one-off note on the booking dialog; adapters pass it as the courier note. Size M; depends on 659; shared files: settings registry; booking flow.
- **Filed under:** [S28 Wave 2 — couriers](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s28-wave-2--couriers)
- **What was built** (from the Build status row):
  - Settings and named keys: `delivery.courier.messages`, `bookInput.note`
  - Tests: Tests: 4 pure, 1 booking and 1 payout (real PostgreSQL), 2 settings
- **Links:** [Register section](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s28-wave-2--couriers) · [README feature section](../../README.md#s28--admin-v5-prototype-alignment--done-201201) · [↑ PR list](#prs-in-this-stage)

## PR 675

**Courier statement match screen (Finance, Couriers) —**

**বাংলায়:** কুরিয়ারের স্টেটমেন্ট মেলানোর স্ক্রিন: না-মেলা লাইন, কুরিয়ারের হিসাব মানলে খরচ হিসেবে ওঠে।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-13
  - Build status row: Courier statement match screen (CN-048; no migration, no new setting, no new permission): a monthly statement page per courier at `/admin/delivery/couriers/[id]/statement?month=` (linked from Courier 360 › Money) with the month's statements and totals, the lines that still do not match, the figures accepted that month and the claims still to receive from that courier (open and sent, with the late count). "Accept the courier figure" (`payments.settle`, checked in the route and the service) is offered only on a CHARGE_DIFFERS line whose courier charge is above ours: the part above ours becomes ONE cost entry on the books' delivery line (the new books hook `courierDifference` → `recordStatementCost` kind `COURIER_DIFFERENCE`, once per statement line, under the books' own courier-charges switch that ships off) and the line is resolved with that said and audited; a cost the books did not take (switch off, no books link, over the line limit, day closed, no hook) resolves nothing and the screen says why (`COST_NOT_BOOKED`). It is a record of the shop's own cost: nothing is paid, received or moved, the courier's statement is never changed, nothing is deleted. Route `POST /api/admin/delivery/statement-lines/:id/accept`. Courier 360 › Money uses the same lines component. Bengali guides: new courier-statement.md, Courier 360 and index updated. Tests: 3 payments and 1 inventory (real PostgreSQL), 1 pure
- **What it does (original scope):** **Courier statement match screen (Finance, Couriers)** — Screen over the courier-statement import and match: lines that do not match, "Accept the courier figure" books a courier cost, monthly statement, claims-to-receive line. Size M; depends on 670; shared files: sections.ts (Money tab, small).
- **Filed under:** [S28 Wave 2 — couriers](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s28-wave-2--couriers)
- **What was built** (from the Build status row):
  - Code and files: `POST /api/admin/delivery/statement-lines/:id/accept`
  - Routes: `/admin/delivery/couriers/[id]/statement?month=`
  - Settings and named keys: `payments.settle`
  - Names in the code: `courierDifference`, `recordStatementCost`, `COURIER_DIFFERENCE`, `COST_NOT_BOOKED`
  - Tests: Tests: 3 payments and 1 inventory (real PostgreSQL), 1 pure

## PR 718

**Website › Policies —**

**বাংলায়:** ওয়েবসাইটে নতুন পলিসি ট্যাব: নয়টা পলিসি পেজ ইংরেজি আর বাংলায় লেখা যায়, প্রিভিউ দেখা যায়, চালু না খসড়া বোঝা যায়, ভার্সনের ইতিহাস থেকে ফেরানো যায়; আপনার লেখা ছাড়া কিছু বসে না আর আগের কিছু মোছা হয় না।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-14
  - Build status row: Website › Policies (closeout lane H). New tab of Website with the nine policy pages (Terms, Privacy, Delivery, Exchange & returns, Payment & COD and the four new ones: Cancellation & Refund, Wallet & coupons, Reviews, Cookies), each in English and Bengali with a live preview, a Live / Draft state, last edited by and when, the public link and a version history (save draft, publish, restore as a new draft; nothing deleted) kept in `ContentRevision`; the five pages the shop had keep reading `pages.text` (kept as version 1, publish writes back through Settings › Policies & texts), the four new ones are read by `/help/<slug>` from the history, and the sitemap lists published pages only; no migration, no new setting or permission key; `AWAITING` entry `website.policies` removed
- **What it does (original scope):** **Website › Policies** — The prototype's Website › Policies tab, never built before (GAP-MAP: "Policies: 5 new pages (Payment and COD, Cancellation and Refund, Wallet and coupons, Reviews, Cookies), at-a-glance boxes, section cards, history; placed under Website", wave 5 follow-up; owner order 14 Nov 2026). A tab of Website lists the nine policy pages of the prototype in its order (Terms, Privacy, Delivery, Exchange & returns, Payment & COD, then the four new ones Cancellation & Refund, Wallet & coupons, Reviews, Cookies). Each page: title, line under it and text in English and Bengali, a live preview in either language, its state (Live, Live with a newer draft waiting, Draft), who changed it last and when, the link to its public page, and a version history kept in `ContentRevision` (entityType `policy`; additive, nothing deleted: a save edits the one open draft, Publish makes it live and marks the old one replaced, Restore brings an old version back as a NEW draft). The five pages the shop already had keep reading their words from `pages.text` (Settings › Policies & texts): what is there is kept as version 1 the first time the tab opens, a later change made in Settings is adopted as a new version, and Publish writes back through that screen's own save (same checks and audit), so no data is lost and the public pages did not change; the four new pages' live words are read by `/help/<slug>` straight from the history ("Coming soon" until published), and the sitemap lists published policy pages only. The words are the owner's: nothing is written for him, a page with no words is an empty draft, a new page needs its title and text to go live. Seeing needs `website.read`, changing `settings.write` (no new permission key); audit names the page and version, never the words. No migration, no new setting (the same `ContentRevision` table). Bengali guide `docs/admin-guide/pages/website/policies.md`. Size M; depends on 384 (Policies & texts), 75 (help pages), 598 (ContentRevision), 659 (menu); shared files: none beyond the menu model (`sections.ts`, `nav-v5.ts` `AWAITING`).

## PR 728

**Practice pictures load (the first live deploy of PR 725 was rolled back by its own smoke test: every sample picture answered 404; S28; no …**

**বাংলায়:** প্র্যাকটিস শপের নমুনা ছবি এখন ঠিকঠাক খোলে: ছবির সাইজের ফাইলের নামে বড় হাতের অক্ষর ছিল বলে সার্ভার সেগুলো দিত না (ফলে সব ছবি 404), এখন নাম সবসময় ছোট হাতের; ছবি প্রোডাক্টে বসানোর আগে ফাইল স্টোরেজে আছে কি না দেখা হয়, হারানো ছবি আবার বানিয়ে বসানো হয়, আর স্টোরেজ যদি শুধু একটা সার্ভারের মেমরিতে থাকে তাহলে ছবি বানানো থেমে থাকে

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-15
  - Build status row: Practice pictures that load: the sizes of a practice picture were named with a capital colour code, which the /media route refuses (a 404 on every sample picture); a size name is now always lower case, the files of a picture are checked in storage before it is put on a product, lost files are drawn again and put back, and no picture is made while the storage lives in one server process only (S28; no migration, no new setting; the admin theme setting's version is raised so the deploy no longer warns).
- **What it does (original scope):** **Practice pictures load** (the first live deploy of PR 725 was rolled back by its own smoke test: every sample picture answered 404; S28; no migration, no new setting, no new key): the cause was the sizes' file names, which carried the colour code in capitals (`…-trouser-556B2F-front-card…`) while the `/media` route serves only lower-case names (`isRenditionKey`), so the address was right (`/media/media/s1/…` is the normal address of every upload: the storage key itself starts with `media/`) but the route refused it. A size's slug is now always `a-z`, `0-9`, `-` (`slugOfKey`), practice file names are lower case, a practice picture is put on a product only after its original and every size are found in storage (`assetFilesExist`), pictures that lost their files or carry the old capital names are drawn again, put back and re-sized by the practice clock (`repairPracticePhotos`, a few per step, under a lease), and no practice picture is made while the storage is the in-process memory store in production (`Storage.volatile`), because the other servers could not see it. Also: the admin theme setting's version is raised (PR 724 changed its default colour without raising it, so the deploy warned). Test on PostgreSQL: the address equals the normal upload address, every size answers 200 through the media route, wiped storage and old capital names are repaired, per-process storage is refused.
- **Filed under:** [S28 Wave 5 — the rest](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s28-wave-5--the-rest)
- **Mentions:** [PR 725](#pr-725), [PR 724](#pr-724)
- **Links:** [Register section](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s28-wave-5--the-rest) · [README feature section](../../README.md#s28--admin-v5-prototype-alignment--done-201201) · [↑ PR list](#prs-in-this-stage)

The cause of the 28 or 30 px (instead of 14 px) between a head and what follows on 18 pages (Bag tier box, Shimmer, Start & search, Feature requests, Blog pipeline, Comments …): those pages are flex columns with their own gap (14 or 16 px) and the head's own 14 px margin came on top; one CSS rule (`lumen-sections.css`) takes the margin off there. **Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-15
  - Build status row: Practice pictures from the first live run still load (S28; no migration, no new setting): sizes made before PR 728 carry a capital colour code in their file name and their rows are already live; the `/media` route refused them (404 on the home page, search, collections and the admin product list right after the deploy of PR 728, which was rolled back). The route now serves a recorded size whatever the letter case of its name (only a size the library lists is ever served; nothing else gets through), finds a re-made size by its old capital-letter address, and draws a practice picture whose file is missing again on the spot instead of answering 404.
- **What it does (original scope):** **Legacy practice pictures still load** (the deploy of PR 728, 932528a4, was rolled back by the smoke test: 15 pages saw 404 for sizes whose file names still held a capital colour code; S28; no migration, no new setting, no new key): sizes made by the earlier code are already rows in the library, named like `practice-polo-F5F5F5-front-card.<hash>.avif`, and `isRenditionKey` served lower case only, so they answered 404 the moment the new version went live, before the keeper's repair (8 s after boot, a few a minute) could reach them. Fix: `isRenditionKey` accepts letters of either case in the name part (same folder shape, same hash and format rules, no way out of the folder; the route still serves only a size the library lists); `renditionFile` also looks a key up in lower case, so the old address of a size made again under its lower-case name keeps working; the `/media` handler draws a missing practice picture again on the spot (`healPracticeRendition`, same bytes, same checksum, then the sizes) and serves it; a picture that cannot be drawn again to the same bytes, or any other asset, still answers 404. Tests: naming (capital key served, traversal and `_` refused), and the practice database test serves a capital-letter row (file present) and a capital-letter row with a wiped storage with 200, and the old address after the repair. Dated update on PR 728.
- **Filed under:** [S28 Wave 5 — the rest](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s28-wave-5--the-rest)

  - Routes: `/media`
